ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which mark gives the short vowel 'i'? (1 mark)
   A. fatHa, a line above the letter
   B. kasra, a small line below the letter
   C. Damma, a curl above the letter
   D. shadda

2. What does the Arabic word بَيْتٌ (bayt) mean? (1 mark)
   A. kitchen
   B. pen
   C. house
   D. book

3. What is word spacing? (1 mark)
   A. The small space between words
   B. The height of letters
   C. The number of dots
   D. The colour of ink

4. What is the name of the Arabic letter ح? (1 mark)
   A. Haa
   B. Saad
   C. nuun
   D. miim

5. What does the Arabic word السَّبْتُ (as-sabt) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Friday
   B. yesterday
   C. Saturday
   D. week

6. What is the name of the Arabic letter ل? (1 mark)
   A. laam
   B. faa
   C. Daad
   D. yaa

7. Which Arabic sentence means "Above the table there is a balloon." (1 mark)
   A. عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كَعْكَةٌ
   B. هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ
   C. فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ
   D. الْأَصْدِقَاءُ فِي الْحَفْلَةِ

8. What does the Arabic word مِفْتَاحٌ (miftaah) mean? (1 mark)
   A. key
   B. door
   C. lamp
   D. cup

9. Which Arabic sentence means "In the kitchen there is a table." (1 mark)
   A. فِي الْغُرْفَةِ سَرِيرٌ
   B. فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ
   C. هَذِهِ غُرْفَتِي
   D. أُحِبُّ بَيْتِي

10. How do you read the syllable سُ? (1 mark)
   A. su
   B. na
   C. bu
   D. laa

11. Which letter completes the word _َمٌ to make fam (mouth)? (1 mark)
   A. م (miim)
   B. ف (faa)
   C. ق (qaaf)
   D. ك (kaaf)

12. What does the Arabic word ذُرَةٌ (dhura) mean? (1 mark)
   A. maize
   B. chicken
   C. fruit
   D. fish

13. Which Arabic word means "read"? (1 mark)
   A. اُخْرُجْ
   B. ارْفَعْ يَدَكَ
   C. افْتَحِ الْبَابَ
   D. اِقْرَأْ

14. What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا جِسْمِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have two hands.
   B. This is my body.
   C. I have two eyes.
   D. My body is strong.

15. What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am well, thanks be to God.
   B. My name is Ahmad.
   C. I am a pupil (boy).
   D. I am a pupil (girl).

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give two ways of keeping household items safe. (2 marks) (2 marks)

17. Translate into English: alʿabu yawma s-sabt (2 marks)

18. Translate into English: asmaʿu bi-udhunii (2 marks)

19. Give two tips for pronouncing Arabic greetings correctly. (2 marks) (2 marks)

20. Write five weather or environment words in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

21. Translate into English: fii l-matbakhi taawila wa kursii. (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — kasra, a small line below the letter
   kasra is written below the letter and gives the vowel i.

2. C — house
   بَيْتٌ (bayt) means house.

3. A — The small space between words
   Word spacing is the neat gap between one word and the next.

4. A — Haa
   The letter ح is called Haa.

5. C — Saturday
   السَّبْتُ (as-sabt) means Saturday.

6. A — laam
   The letter ل is called laam.

7. C — فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ
   فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ (fawqa t-taawilati baaluun) means: Above the table there is a balloon.

8. A — key
   مِفْتَاحٌ (miftaah) means key.

9. B — فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ
   فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ (fii l-matbakhi taawila) means: In the kitchen there is a table.

10. A — su
   سُ is read su.

11. B — ف (faa)
   The word fam (فَمٌ) starts with faa, which has one dot above.

12. A — maize
   ذُرَةٌ (dhura) means maize.

13. D — اِقْرَأْ
   اِقْرَأْ (iqraʾ) means read.

14. B — This is my body.
   هَذَا جِسْمِي (haadhaa jismii) means: This is my body.

15. A — I am well, thanks be to God.
   أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (anaa bi-khayr, al-hamdu lillaah) means: I am well, thanks be to God.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep the key in a safe place such as the cupboard; keep knives out of reach of small children; keep lamps away from water.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each safe way.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: I play on Saturday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: I hear with my ear.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Listen to the teacher first and copy; say long vowels for longer than short vowels; practise the throat sounds kh and ʿ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible tip.

20. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example shams (sun), sahaab (clouds), matar (rain), riih (wind), samaa' (sky).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part.
